1) Hosted API + BAA: can Redwood support PHI on the Hosted API under a standard BAA, or do you require Dedicated/Private for PHI workloads?

Hi Sara — looping in technical details to answer your items from Marissa's recap. TL;DR: for PHI-backed workloads we generally recommend Dedicated or Private VPC — Hosted API is not the recommended path unless data is de-identified or you use a strict proxying architecture. Details below.

1) Hosted API + BAA: Hosted API is available under a BAA for some customers, but we cannot guarantee tenant isolation or customer-managed KMS in the standard Hosted offering. If ELARA requires customer-managed keys or strict tenancy isolation, Hosted is likely insufficient.

2) SOC2 report: attaching the full SOC2 Type II report (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf). It includes the scope and testing period (Jan–Dec 2026) and our control descriptions.

3) KMS/BYOK: Private VPC supports full BYOK (customer-managed KMS/HSM support) and the Private offering supports on-prem HSM integration. Dedicated supports KMS integration (bring-your-own-key with supported cloud KMS providers) when deployed in a VPC-enabled tenancy — I’ve attached a short Network_Diagram_Dedicated_v1.png and a one-page KMS note in the comparison spreadsheet.

4) Audit logs & retention: we can stream audit logs, access logs, and API request traces to your S3 or to a logging endpoint (CloudWatch/Stackdriver). Retention can be controlled on your side; Redwood can provide the exports and a standard retention export job for long-term archival.

5) Pen test: Redwood performs annual third-party penetration testing. We can share a redacted executive summary; for higher-sensitivity customers we can provide additional evidence under an NDA.

Next steps I recommend:
- Elara confirms whether you require BYOK/HSM and long-term log retention (yes/no) — if yes, Private or Dedicated with VPC looks right.
- If Dedicated is preferred, we’ll prepare a short SOW and cost estimate; if Private required, we’ll schedule an infra scoping call to detail networking and installation timeline.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf; Network_Diagram_Dedicated_v1.png; Deployment_Mode_Comparison_Elara.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a call next week to walk the diagram.
